79932.subject: 🏦 Coinbase wins massive CFTC approval
79932.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $84,108 (0.7%) | **ETH** $2,723 (1.2%) | **SOL** $121 (1.2%)

* Coinbase receives CFTC approval to launch its own [US crypto derivatives clearinghouse](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2104867125483516360) — Becomes [first crypto firm](https://x.com/CoinDesk/status/2104865267570422228) to hold exchange, broker and clearinghouse registrations with USDC collateral and 24/7 settlement

* [Anthropic IPO filing ](https://x.com/BullTheoryio/status/2104778333699617167)warns its models could pose “existential risks to humanity” and potentially resist shutdown

* Clearing House taps Quant to power bank tokenization network, QNT rallies [158.3%](https://x.com/BSCNews/status/2103581807631356168)

* Blockchain.com targets a [$500 million](https://x.com/wallstengine/status/2104653820475400617) US IPO at $4-6 billion valuation

* ZachXBT says Chinese actors are laundering [$387M](https://x.com/zachxbt/status/2104528688469647700) Bitget exploit funds for DPRK attackers — NEAR Intents blocks over [$50M](https://x.com/SolanaFloor/status/2104602998983012543) in Bitget hack flows, waives bounty share

* AMD agrees to acquire World Labs in [$8.2 billion](https://x.com/StockMKTNewz/status/2104664505561325938) all-stock deal

* AI startup Instinct raises $1B Series C, valuation [quadruples to $10B](https://x.com/Techmeme/status/2104555143798854020)

* Solana launchpad Paid launches claim portal after X Money blocks fee payouts, token [drops 38%](https://x.com/SolanaFloor/status/2104726809837449416)

* BitMine buys 17,362 ETH, lifting total holdings above [6 million ETH](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2104549917087961576)

* Bitcoin ETFs log [$31.1 million](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2104801548153061440) in inflows, extending streak to eight days

* Senate investigation finds [84%](https://cryptobriefing.com/senate-investigation-tether-iran-sanctions/) of sanctioned crypto wallets use USDT for Iran — Tether says it helped freeze nearly [$550 million](https://x.com/CoinGapeMedia/status/2104563670605066248) in USDT linked to Iran

* Meta launches [Meta Enterprise Platform](https://x.com/wallstengine/status/2104550837033091292) to sell AI tools to businesses

* OpenAI reportedly cancels [GPT-6.1 Astra](https://x.com/wallstengine/status/2104694678444712189) release over safety concerns

* Claude launches[ Sonnet 5.5](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2104633115620823187?s=20) — Runs over 30% faster and costs up to 30% less than Sonnet 5 for most work while [beating Opus 5.5](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2104633119412523294?s=20) on some coding benchmarks

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Rising Treasury yields, pricier oil and fresh Fed-hike bets pulled Bitcoin back to $83K. Yet the institutional pipeline keeps widening, from Coinbase's new clearinghouse and Citi's stablecoin rails to Blockchain.com's IPO push. 📉 Bitcoin Slips to $83K as Yields and Oil Stoke Fed-Hike Fears Bitcoin fell to just above $83,000 early Tuesday as climbing U.S. Treasury yields and a second straight day of rising oil prices revived inflation worries and bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike. The pressure followed President Trump's rejection of Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and traders are now bracing for Wednesday's PCE inflation print. Zcash led losses among major tokens with a 12% drop, while crypto sentiment gauges remain in "greed" territory, in sharp contrast with the fear gripping equities. Read full story 🏛️ CFTC Clears Coinbase to Run Its Own USDC-Native Clearinghouse The CFTC registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a derivatives clearing organization on September 28, completing Coinbase's in-house U.S. derivatives stack of exchange, broker and clearinghouse. The approval covers only fully collateralized futures, options on futures and swaps, using USDC as collateral with 24/7 settlement. Margined products and the upcoming single-stock perpetuals will continue to rely on outside clearing partners. More details 🏦 Citi Opens Its Checkout to Stablecoins via Coinbase Citi's institutional clients can now accept stablecoin payments through the bank's Spring by Citi merchant platform, with Coinbase running the blockchain rails and converting tokens into fiat before Citi settles the funds. In the other direction, Coinbase Virtual Accounts will run on Citi's Virtual Account Wallet, automatically converting incoming fiat into stablecoins. Both products launch first in the U.S., expanding a partnership the two firms started in October 2025. That is well below the $14 billion the company commanded in 2022.
